about.en: CTK is the native token of Shentu Chain, a security-focused delegated proof-of-stake blockchain built with the Cosmos SDK and originally incubated by CertiK, which is why the token was first called CertiK Token. CTK is used for staking, governance and fees on Shentu Chain and for the chain's security services such as on-chain bounties; it also circulates as a BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain at 0xa8c2b8eec3d368c0253ad3dae65a5f2bbb89c929.
